meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会接入 Linear：当所连团队的 issue 出现新评论时，它会自动以评论形式回复，无需 @ 提及；每个 issue 的评论串作为一个独立对话，会话按线程隔离。
howto.when: 当所连接的 Linear 团队中有 issue 收到新评论时触发，无需 @ 提及；每条评论都会进入该 issue 的独立对话线程。

say.text: 回复 Linear 上 ENG 团队最新 issue 的评论
say.note: 它会读取该 issue 的评论串并以评论回复。

say.text: 把 Linear 的 ENG 团队重新接到默认 agent
say.note: 重新执行 wiring，把该团队路由到指定 agent。

say.text: 帮我排查 Linear 评论没到达 agent 的原因
say.note: 按排查步骤检查 webhook 和凭据设置。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude connects to Linear: whenever a new comment appears on an issue in the connected team, it automatically replies as a comment, no @-mention required. Each issue's comment thread becomes its own conversation, isolated per thread.
howto.when_en: Triggered when an issue in the configured Linear team receives a new comment, without needing an @-mention. Each comment enters the issue's own thread conversation.

say_en.text: Reply to the latest comment on ENG issue in Linear.
say_en.note: It reads that issue's thread and replies as a comment.

say_en.text: Rewire the ENG Linear team to the default agent.
say_en.note: Reruns the wiring so that team routes to the agent.

say_en.text: Help me debug why Linear comments aren't reaching the agent.
say_en.note: Checks webhook and credentials per troubleshooting steps.
